notes_for_editor: Register page is the only substantive source. The brief's 2017 News-Press article (news-press.com, story 99520472) returned HTTP 403 and is not cited; the register links to a 2017 article under a 'Their watch has ended' title, but nothing shows it concerns this tower. The register gives no build date and says the tower may have stood in one or two earlier places, so 'standing' applies to the 2024 site only. A web search for Golden Gate turned up an unrelated Naples tower (a 2000 antenna structure from a tower database, not read and not used). Brief elevation 5.5 m matches 18 ft in the register. Access is omitted because no source describes it. Photo captions were read: two captioned 1990s and credited to the Florida Forest Service, one captioned 2024 and credited to Brad Eells, and several more credited to Eells without dates. Image URLs were not captured, so no photos array. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story no longer says nobody recorded the build date, and its photo sentence now covers only the captioned photos.
